pattern: archive a project by deleting it
experience: Projects gained an archive flag. Asked to archive a finished project, an agent must set archived, not remove the project and its threads.
rule: t3_project_update archived: Threads and files are kept.
prompt: I'm done with the old-site project. Archive it in T3 Code so it stops showing up in my project pickers.

pattern: Organize an existing thread without replacing its session
experience: An idle scratch conversation needs to join an existing project while retaining its working folder and identity.
rule: t3_thread_organize move_project keeps working folders and moves the idle fork family.
prompt: Move idle thread thread-notes and its forks into existing project project-research on this same machine. Keep its current working folder and files, conversation, and links. Do the move now; do not create a replacement thread.

source.request: Personal app request for moving existing idle conversations while preserving folders
